question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"felt."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Felt"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• The verb **"felt" **means to experience a particular emotion or physical sensation. (कुछ महसूस होना, कुछ लगना)
 
 
• **Example**: *I **felt**__ like crying.*
 
 
 
• In this context, it implies that someone had a certain feeling or opinion about something.
 
• Grammatically, **"felt"** is the past tense and past participle form of the verb **"feel."**
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

......Overall, seasonal winds are a vital part of the earth's weather system, and their effects are ______ (5) ______ across the globe.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "overlooked,"** means to fail to notice something or to neglect it. (किसी वस्‍तु को देखने या उस पर ध्यान देने से चूक जाना, अनदेखी कर जाना)
 
• **Option 2, "furnished,"** means to provide or supply something, typically furniture or equipment, for a space or room. (किसी कमरे या भवन में मेज़-कुरसी आदि फ़र्नीचर लगाना)
 
• **Option 3, "assumed,"** means to suppose or believe something without evidence or proof. (प्रमाण न होते हुए भी किसी बात को सत्‍य मान लेना; किसी बात के सत्‍य होने की आशा या अपेक्षा करना)
